sections.title: The Library
sections.blurb: Attendance, where visitors come from, how far they travel, and the markets that send them.

sections.title: The park and Medora
sections.blurb: Theodore Roosevelt National Park visits, Painted Canyon, overnight stays, campgrounds and park visitor spending.

sections.title: Getting here
sections.blurb: Roads into Medora and across the state lines, the region's airports, where air travelers start, and the Canadian border.

sections.title: The local economy
sections.blurb: Medora and corridor-town taxes, county sales, visitor spending studies and tourism jobs.

sections.title: The region
sections.blurb: North Dakota next to Montana, South Dakota, Wyoming and Canada, each on the same measures, plus the comparison parks.

sections.title: Demand and context
sections.blurb: Search and Wikipedia interest, smoke days, retail, weather, gas, exchange rate and oil — the things that move visitation that aren't the Library.
